title: Inject Where It Matters: Objective-Dependent Feature Control in Rectified-Flow Image Editing
abstract: arXiv:2611.25811v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many prompt-driven FLUX editing methods rely on injecting source features into target-conditioned generation, creating an inherent trade-off between source preservation and the desired edit. We address this problem by controlling where source features are injected and which transformer blocks are used. First, we introduce adaptive masks that spatially gate feature injection using differences between source- and target-conditioned block outputs at matched inversion states. Second, we use REINFORCE to select Top-K injection blocks under different preservation-editability objectives. The selected blocks are fixed at inference and require no online search. On PIE-Bench with FLUX.1-dev, spatial masking controls the alignment-preservation trade-off. translated_title: 注入到关键之处：整流流图像编辑中基于目标的特征控制
translated_abstract: 许多基于提示词的 FLUX 图像编辑方法依赖于将源图像特征注入到以目标提示词为条件的生成过程中，这在源图像保留与期望编辑效果之间造成了固有的权衡。我们通过控制源特征注入的位置以及所使用的 transformer 块来解决这个问题。首先，我们引入自适应掩码，利用匹配反演状态下源条件与目标条件块输出之间的差异，在空间上对特征注入进行门控。其次，我们使用 REINFORCE 算法在不同的“保留-可编辑性”目标下选择 Top-K 注入块。所选的块在推理阶段固定，无需在线搜索。在基于 FLUX.1-dev 的 PIE-Bench 基准上，空间掩码能够控制对齐与保留之间的权衡。在 60 个验证样本上，在相同的掩码流程下，学习到的九个块集合比 18 个块的 RF-Edit 集合具有更低的全图 LPIPS，同时在对齐度上略低。在 50 个随机九个……
tldr: 该论文提出自适应掩码和基于 REINFORCE 学习的 Top-K 关键块选择方法，通过控制源特征的注入位置和注入的 transformer 块，实现了整流流图像编辑中源保留与编辑效果之间的可控权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces adaptive masks and REINFORCE-based Top-K block selection to control where source features are injected and which transformer blocks are used, achieving a controllable trade-off between source preservation and editability in rectified-flow image editing.
